observed_result.summary: Delegation: the child is server-enforced to its subset, a broader or longer child is refused, the child handle has no owner functions, the parent's end cascades and the child's next login fails (R-AU-07, R-SE-03). The managed rows.

limitations: deferred_with_decision to M04's exit (m05-plan Q9): A28's forwarding and container rows.

Status discipline (m05-plan §3, M01 rule E15): verified rows mean the required tests ran and passed on that platform in this run; not an independent review of the units. The lowest-row rule applies: a blocked owner-input row (m05-plan §7: B2, B7, B9, B12) keeps its record blocked, and no claim is widened to cover it.

Linux and Windows binaries are cross-built on the macOS host with zig and run natively on the hosts (Windows: built and run natively on the PC); tests that read the repository at its compile-time path read it through HM_REPO_ROOT, which the harnesses set.
Two environments, one OS user: A16 runs two native environments in scratch homes on each platform; the WSL and container pairs are M04's exit (plan Q9).

The hook journeys need a Unix shell: native Windows has no shell integration (owner question Q6) and uses run and ordinary ssh; the WSL row runs bash and zsh inside one disposable distribution (ruling I-19).
Proptest regression files resolve at compile-time source paths: persisted regression seeds replay on macOS only; the fixed default seeds run everywhere.

Every fixture is disposable: per-run keys, the loopback fixture sshd, disposable ssh-agents with a scratch HOME, scratch configuration and Heimdall homes, a disposable WSL distribution; the owners' keys, agents, keychains, ~/.ssh and Git configuration are never test material.

The WSL hook row's harness stops before any import unless its first census (wsl --list --quiet) succeeds: on a PC with no WSL distribution, where that listing exits nonzero, the row cannot run and fails closed (ruled in M05 W4; the owner's PC has its own distribution).

Pre-final runs at earlier candidates (d81abda6, 959936c4, 056a1692), the superseded Windows run at 84d7c44e (exit-84d7c44e/windows-84d7c44e-superseded: passed, with A02's result line unreadable) and the failed first WSL attempt at 84d7c44e (exit-84d7c44e/wsl-distro-attempt1-failed: the harness refused its own distribution, no journey ran) are kept beside this run and are not evidence for it.

The WSL hook row ran on kernel 6.18.58.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2, newer than the 6.8.0 Linux floor (the devbox's kernel): a WSL host's kernel is its own, the real-world case that M03-F1's version gating (its R02 rule, WSL included) must classify.
